deterministic.product_description: Rear lamp  — exterior lighting & signalling module combining multiple light functions, lens, and retro-reflector in a single housing.
deterministic.vehicle_category_note: M1 — passenger car. UNECE lighting regulations referenced apply across M and N categories.

parts.name: Rear position lamp
parts.function: Emits red light to the rear to indicate the presence and width of the vehicle
parts.material: LED modules on PCB (light source); PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating (reflector surface)
parts.evidence_drawing: Reflector callout text 'rear position lamp: 4 to 17 cd on axis' (illustrative); LED array behind reflector cells

parts.name: Stop lamp
parts.function: Emits red light to the rear, higher intensity, when service brake is applied
parts.evidence_drawing: LED modules on PCB callout text 'stop lamp: 60 to 185 cd on axis' (illustrative)

parts.name: Reversing lamp
parts.function: Illuminates the road to the rear and warns road users that the vehicle is reversing
parts.evidence_drawing: Housing callout text 'reversing lamp visible to 45° outboard' (illustrative, refers to reversing lamp function, not housing); separate clear window on outer lens and separate compartment in reflector

parts.name: Outer lens
parts.function: Closes the lamp, transmits light and defines red colour of signal light
parts.evidence_drawing: Front-most component in exploded view; callout 'red, within the chromaticity limits'; rectangular window area visible in lens

parts.name: Retro-reflector
parts.function: Passive conspicuity by reflecting incident light back towards its source
parts.regulated_function: rear retro-reflector, non-triangular (Class IA or IB)
parts.evidence_drawing: Small rectangular hatched prism element between lens and seal; callout 'reflectivity at 5° angle of incidence'

parts.name: Reflector
parts.function: Optical reflector shaping light distribution of the LED light sources
parts.evidence_spec: Reflector surface | PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating
parts.evidence_drawing: Third layer with array of reflector cups and separate compartments; labelled 'Reflector'

parts.name: LED modules on PCB
parts.function: Light sources and electronic circuit board powering signal functions
parts.evidence_spec: Light source | LED modules on PCB
parts.evidence_drawing: Flat board with grid of LED packages, connector-like strip and a square component; labelled 'LED modules on PCB'

parts.name: Housing
parts.function: Structural body carrying optical and electronic parts; attachment to vehicle body
parts.evidence_drawing: Rear-most deep tray with mounting holes; labelled 'Housing'

parts.name: Seal / gasket
parts.function: Seals lens-to-housing joint against water and dust ingress
parts.evidence_drawing: Thin perimeter ring between lens and reflector; callout 'no water ingress after the spray test'

parts.name: Fasteners / clips
parts.function: Fix lamp to vehicle and maintain aim
parts.evidence_spec: Fasteners / clips | PA, POM, or steel
parts.evidence_drawing: Three screws/pins shown behind housing; callout 'lamp stays aimed under vibration'

electronic_subassemblies: LED modules on PCB (LED light sources and driving circuitry)
regulated_functions: rear retro-reflector, non-triangular (Class IA or IB)
search_terms: installation of lighting and light-signalling devices
drawing_observations: Exploded view along a common axis: outer lens, retro-reflector, seal/gasket, reflector, LED PCB, housing, fasteners.
Outer lens shows a separate rectangular window area, likely for the reversing lamp.
Retro-reflector is a separate small rectangular prismatic insert between lens and gasket.
Reflector has an array of LED reflector cups plus distinct compartments for separate functions.
PCB carries a grid of LED packages, a square component and a connector-like strip.
Housing is a deep tray with mounting holes; three screw/clip fasteners shown.

Illustrative callouts: red within chromaticity limits; retro-reflector reflectivity at 5° incidence; no water ingress after spray test; rear position lamp 4 to 17 cd on axis; stop lamp 60 to 185 cd on axis; reversing lamp visible to 45° outboard; lamp stays aimed under vibration.
Callouts for reflector, PCB and housing describe lamp functions (rear position, stop, reversing) rather than those parts.
